title: Culture: Family traditions around the world

sentences.en: The idea of the family is important all over the world and many countries have special occasions to celebrate it.
sentences.zh: 家庭这个理念在世界各地都很重要，许多国家都有特别的场合来庆祝它。

sentences.en: Let’s look at a few.
sentences.zh: 我们来看几个例子。

sentences.en: In Germany, the first day at school is a very important time for all children.
sentences.zh: 在德国，开学第一天对所有孩子来说都是很重要的时刻。

sentences.en: There is a special event called an Einschulung.
sentences.zh: 有一个特别的活动叫入学典礼。

sentences.en: Everyone in the family meets to give the child presents, like pens and books, for their new school life.
sentences.zh: 全家人都会聚在一起，送给孩子钢笔、书本等礼物，祝福他们开启新的学校生活。

sentences.en: For the first day of school, parents give their children a large paper cone called a Schultüte.
sentences.zh: 开学第一天，父母会送给孩子一个大大的纸锥形入学彩袋。

sentences.en: Inside there are things for school and sweets.
sentences.zh: 里面装着学习用品和糖果。

sentences.en: In traditional Japanese houses you often find a butsudan.
sentences.zh: 在日本传统的房子里，你常常会看到一个佛坛。

sentences.en: A butsudan is a special place where you go to remember your dead relatives.
sentences.zh: 佛坛是一个专门用来纪念已故亲人的地方。

sentences.en: People usually put things on the butsudan for their ancestors: a book, some flowers or a bowl of rice, for example.
sentences.zh: 人们通常会在佛坛上放些东西祭奠祖先，比如一本书、一些花或者一碗米饭。

sentences.en: Adults also tell stories about these people to their children so they are not forgotten.
sentences.zh: 大人也会把这些人的故事讲给孩子听，这样他们就不会被忘记。

sentences.en: Pets are popular in many cultures around the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界许多文化中，养宠物都很流行。

sentences.en: Looking after an animal helps a child learn how to be responsible.
sentences.zh: 照顾动物能教会孩子如何承担责任。

sentences.en: Every year in India there is a Hindu festival called Thai Pongal.
sentences.zh: 每年印度都有一个印度教节日，叫蓬加尔节。

sentences.en: During the festival families feed cows and birds to give thanks for these animals.
sentences.zh: 节日期间，家家户户会喂牛和鸟，以此感谢这些动物。

sentences.en: Children also learn that all living things are connected and must share the world together.
sentences.zh: 孩子们也会明白，所有生物都是相连的，必须共同分享这个世界。

sentences.en: In the Netherlands people celebrate the winter holiday on the 5th December.
sentences.zh: 在荷兰，人们在 12 月 5 日庆祝冬季节日。

sentences.en: This holiday is called Sinterklaas.
sentences.zh: 这个节日叫圣尼古拉斯节。

sentences.en: People give each other presents, but they also have a very special tradition.
sentences.zh: 人们互送礼物，但也有一个非常特别的传统。

sentences.en: Each member of the family writes their name on a piece of paper and puts it in a hat.
sentences.zh: 家里每个人把自己的名字写在纸上，放进一顶帽子里。

sentences.en: Everyone then takes a name from the hat and writes a poem about this person.
sentences.zh: 然后每个人从帽子里抽一个名字，并为这个人写一首诗。

sentences.en: Everyone sits in a circle and reads out their poems.
sentences.zh: 大家围坐成一圈，朗读自己写的诗。
